explication: OpenAgent is a self-hostable personal AI assistant combining LLM chat, RAG, autonomous tools, and workflow automation. A user configures providers and knowledge stores in the web app, then chats with an agent; the agent can retrieve relevant knowledge and invoke tools or MCP servers before returning a response. The backend also exposes administration, workflow, messaging-pipe, and usage-analytics capabilities. The README documents these product branches; several backend relationships below are therefore documented rather than verified from source excerpts.
